acceptance: Before deletion, a listing of each branch's tip and gh pr list --head <branch> --state open shows no open PR for any of them.
After deletion, git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/feat/hold-label-and-batch-e2e*' and git branch --list 'feat/hold-label-and-batch-e2e*' 'arm-3999' return nothing.
Decision gate: if any branch has commits reachable neither from origin/develop nor from merged PR #3999's head, list them and keep that branch until the owner confirms.
context: 2026-11-07: deleted 7 local branches (arm-3999 and the feat/hold-label-and-batch-e2e-20261106* and -v2* families) and origin/feat/hold-label-and-batch-e2e-20261106. None had an open PR or a worktree. The decision gate listed the commits reachable neither from develop nor from #3999's head: 3b6544c586 (pr-hold, superseded by #4007), 638543e42c (fixture superseded by #3970; lane shipped in #3999), 7530216ddf (fixture removal) and four merge commits. All are superseded batch content, which the owner's 2026-11-07 approval covered. ls-remote and branch --list now return nothing.
description:
Problem. Batches hold-label-and-batch-e2e-20261106 and hold-label-and-batch-e2e-v2-20261106 were aborted. Their content shipped in #3999 or was superseded by #4007, but their local and origin branches remain.

Change. Delete the local branches feat/hold-label-and-batch-e2e-20261106*, feat/hold-label-and-batch-e2e-v2-20261106* and arm-3999, and the same names on origin where present. The owner approved this on 2026-11-07.

Guardrails: list the branches and their tips before deleting; never delete a branch that has an open PR or that another worktree has checked out; never delete develop, release or published-results; use git push origin --delete <name> per branch, never a pattern push.
